name: justrouting
description: Road routing, travel-time matrices, geocoding, and fleet optimization for Southeast Asia. Car and motorcycle profiles.
long_description:
The JustRouting MCP server gives Claude access to the JustRouting routing API:

- **route** - driving or motorcycle routes between two locations, with distance, travel duration and route geometry
- **geocode** - turn place names and addresses into coordinates
- **table** - travel-time and distance matrices between many locations at once
- **optimize** - multi-vehicle routing plans (fleet optimization / vehicle routing problems)

Southeast Asia coverage. Free tier available; sign up at https://justrouting.tech to get an API key.
